remarks: Welcome to 6392 Locust Street Ext. in Lockport, a distinctive 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath split-level offering approximately 3,036 square feet of living space on just over half an acre. The main level features a spacious living room with a wood-burning fireplace that flows into the kitchen and dining area. A dedicated bedroom wing includes three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a primary bedroom with its own private bath. The fourth bedroom sits above the garage and is accessed by its own separate staircase, offering excellent privacy from the rest of the home. Formerly used as a professional office by the previous owner, this flexible space could also serve as a guest room, home office, studio, or private retreat. The walkout lower level is built for entertaining, with a large recreation area, plenty of seating space, and a full retro-style bar. Whether used for game days, movie nights, parties, or everyday gatherings, it offers a dedicated entertainment space with plenty of character. Outside, enjoy a deep backyard with mature trees and an open lawn, plus additional storage space. The attached garage offers substantial room for parking, storage, hobbies, or a workshop, which includes an approximately 360-square-foot rear addition. A wide concrete driveway provides ample off-street parking. Located directly across from George M. Southard Elementary School, this home combines space, privacy, and flexibility in a convenient Lockport location. With 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, over 3,000 square feet, a primary suite, private upper-level bedroom or office, fireplace, walkout lower level, full bar, oversized garage space, and a sizable yard, 6392 Locust Street Ext. offers a rare opportunity to create a truly one-of-a-kind home.
